description: Hate crime counts reported to FBI CDE for the nation, a state, or an agency, summed over a month window from January 1991 through the current year. Returns incidents by bias motivation and bias category, plus counts by offense type, location type, offender race, offender ethnicity, and federal judicial district, with every category CDE reports, zeros included. Narrow to one bias motivation with bias. National scope omits identifiers; state requires only state_abbr; agency requires only ori (look it up with fbi_search_agencies). CDE returns zeros both when nothing was reported and when it does not recognize a state or ORI.

bias.description: Bias motivation code to narrow the counts to, or all (default). With a code, incidents count that motivation plus multiple-bias incidents that include it. Codes: 11 Anti-White; 12 Anti-Black or African American; 13 Anti-American Indian or Alaska Native; 14 Anti-Asian; 15 Anti-Multiple Races, Group; 16 Anti-Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander; 21 Anti-Jewish; 22 Anti-Catholic; 23 Anti-Protestant; 24 Anti-Islamic (Muslim); 25 Anti-Other Religion; 26 Anti-Multiple Religions, Group; 27 Anti-Atheism/Agnosticism; 28 Anti-Church of Jesus Christ; 29 Anti-Jehovah's Witness; 31 Anti-Arab; 32 Anti-Hispanic or Latino; 33 Anti-Other Race/Ethnicity/Ancestry; 41 Anti-Gay (Male); 42 Anti-Lesbian (Female); 43 Anti-Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, or Transgender (Mixed Group); 44 Anti-Heterosexual; 45 Anti-Bisexual; 51 Anti-Physical Disability; 52 Anti-Mental Disability; 61 Anti-Male; 62 Anti-Female; 71 Anti-Transgender; 72 Anti-Gender Non-Conforming; 81 Anti-Eastern Orthodox (Russian, Greek, Other); 82 Anti-Other Christian; 83 Anti-Buddhist; 84 Anti-Hindu; 85 Anti-Sikh.

from_year.description: Start year of the data range (inclusive), 1991 through the current year. The API uses monthly granularity.

ori.description: Nine ASCII-letter/digit ORI code (e.g. CA0010400, DCMPD0000); case-insensitive. Find an agency's ORI with fbi_search_agencies. Only permitted and required for agency scope.

scope.description: Geographic scope: national (omit identifiers), state (only state_abbr), or agency (only ori).

state_abbr.description: Two ASCII-letter state abbreviation (e.g. CA, DC, PR); case-insensitive. Only permitted and required for state scope.

to_year.description: End year of the data range (inclusive), 1991 through the current year.

name: fbi_get_hate_crimes

bias.description: Bias motivation code applied, or all.

bias_label.description: CDE label for the applied bias code; "All bias motivations" for all.

bias_section.description: CDE's bias_section breakdowns summed over the window. Each dimension is counted on its own basis, so the dimensions do not sum to one total or to the incident count.

data_last_updated.description: Date CDE last refreshed hate crime data; absent when CDE omits it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `scope_param_missing`: scope is "state" but state_abbr is missing, or scope is "agency" but ori is missing. `scope_param_incompatible`: Identifiers are supplied for a scope that does not apply them. `year_out_of_range`: from_year or to_year is after the current UTC year. `invalid_date_range`: The complete starting year/month is later than the ending year/month. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

from.description: First month of the summed window (MM-YYYY).

incident_section.description: Incident counts summed over the window.

bias.description: Incidents by bias motivation; Multiple Bias counts incidents with more than one motivation.

notice.description: Present when every count is zero; says whether zeros can also mean an unrecognized state or ORI.

ori.description: Uppercased ORI code; present only for agency scope.

state_abbr.description: Uppercased state abbreviation; present only for state scope.

to.description: Last month of the summed window (MM-YYYY).

title: FBI Get Hate Crimes
